reuse.why: Keeps using getDateWithSkippedWeekend for non-daily schedules, but puts the daily rule inline in getNextDate instead of in that shared weekend helper, and reaches into rrules[0].options for the frequency rather than carrying it in the schedule data.

duplication.why: No copied block within the diff; the take-size ternary is repeated for the forward and reverse lookups.

placement.why: The change is in shared/schedules.ts, but inside getNextDate rather than the weekend helper that all weekend-handling call sites share.

scope.why: Only getNextDate and a test are touched.

maintainability.why: getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts) and the budget schedule template still move daily weekend dates through getDateWithSkippedWeekend, so the rule differs between paths, and the nested skipWeekend/!skipDailyWeekends condition is awkward.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate decides the daily weekend skip itself instead of extending getDateWithSkippedWeekend, which server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts also call.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily rule is added once; the problem is missing coverage, not reshaped copies.

one_place.where: The daily-skip rule lives only in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate; getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and createScheduleList in server/budget/schedule-template.ts still move daily weekend dates via getDateWithSkippedWeekend.
